name: UPENG arbitrary-address burn plus permissionless sync
summary: UPENG exposes burn(address,uint256) to any caller, so the attacker destroyed the Pancake pair's UPENG balance, synced the pair down to one wei and sold its own UPENG into the 1.5 WBNB reserve.
